label: NormalCrafter
description: NormalCrafter: temporally consistent surface normals (camera space) for a frame range. Output: raw EXR at plate size and plate frame numbers, 0-1 encoded; the node shows them decoded to -1..1.
usage: Camera-space normals for a frame range, steady from frame to frame (NormalCrafter, built on Stable Video Diffusion).
Whole input range is sent; tick 'input range' to send only first-last. Desqueeze anamorphic plates first.
Softer than DSINE (the model works at 'resolution', 1024 by default, and is scaled back to plate size), but far less flicker. Use DSINE for stills.
Flicker: raise 'window', or set 'step' below 'window' so the windows overlap. Out of memory: lower 'resolution' first, then 'window', then 'decode chunk'.
Output: 0-1 encoded normals; the node shows them decoded to -1..1.
highlights: what the model sees. 'clip' (default) cuts at 1 and keeps shadows open. 'roll off' compresses highlights but crushes deep shadows.
First run downloads NormalCrafter (4.2 GB) and parts of Stable Video Diffusion XT (1.2 GB, gated: accept it on Hugging Face and log in first).

License (checked 2026-11): NormalCrafter weights Apache-2.0; they run on Stable Video Diffusion XT, which is under the Stability AI Community License (commercial use free under USD 1M annual revenue).

output.tooltip: Normals are vectors, not colour: written and read as raw.

knobs.name: resolution
knobs.label: resolution
knobs.tooltip: Longest side the model sees, 256-2048 in steps of 64. Higher = more detail, much more VRAM. The result is scaled back to plate size.

knobs.name: window
knobs.label: window
knobs.tooltip: Frames processed together (2-64). Bigger = steadier, more VRAM.

knobs.name: step
knobs.label: step
knobs.tooltip: How far the window moves each time (1-64). Below 'window' the windows overlap and are blended, which smooths the joins.

knobs.name: highlights
knobs.label: highlights
knobs.tooltip: What the model sees; only the input changes, as normals are data and aren't converted back. clip (default): values above 1 become 1 (colorimetric), shadows stay open. roll off: the plate goes in through ACES Output - sRGB, so highlights are compressed instead of cut, but deep shadows are crushed. Try roll off on shots with large blown-out areas.

knobs.name: decode_chunk
knobs.label: decode chunk
knobs.tooltip: Frames the VAE decodes at once (1-64). Lower it if decoding runs out of memory.
